verdict.rationale: MX documents a Platform API with an official OpenAPI spec that lets end users connect accounts and retrieves balances and transactions. A probe also found an official MCP server documented at docs.mx.com/mcp, giving agents an API or MCP surface. The evidence shows only general developer API keys with rotation, not scoped or least-privilege credentials, and the MCP surface is a single probe hit with no detail on its tools. missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege credentials for agents, documented MCP tool coverage (link sessions, balances, transactions, connection management), explicit API-level connection management (update/delete/refresh members), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate the platform — create link sessions, retrieve balances and transactions, and manage connections through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: Use the Connect Widget and Platform API to let end users connect to their accounts.
Get the available balance for an end user's financial accounts
With Account Aggregation, connect to end users' financial institutions and retrieve 90 days of data for their accounts and transactions.

official MCP server documented at https://docs.mx.com/mcp
